accountConnection.service_update_required: The running service has not loaded the new account connection API. Restart Nerya and retry. Your inputs are still held in this window for now.
accountConnection.title: Connect a trading account
accountConnection.intro: Choose a platform. Connect securely. Keep control.
accountConnection.editIntro: Update your connection without changing your trading setup.
accountConnection.noMatches: No matching platforms. Try a different name.
accountConnection.providerFailed: Platforms could not be loaded. Your draft is still here.
accountConnection.safeHint: Verification only reads balances. It cannot place orders, transfer funds or enable live trading.
accountConnection.keyHint: Use API credentials from this platform, not your login password. Enable balance-reading access; do not grant withdrawal access.
accountConnection.schemaLoading: Preparing the fields for this platform…
accountConnection.schemaFailed: Connection fields are unavailable. Retry before entering credentials.
accountConnection.keepCredential: Leave blank to keep the saved credential
accountConnection.idHint: Generated automatically. Used by strategies and integrations.
accountConnection.preserved: Existing trading mode, permissions and risk limits are preserved unless you explicitly change them below.
accountConnection.paperDescription: Explore Nerya with a virtual balance. No API keys, wallet or deposit required.
accountConnection.paperNotice: Simulated funds only. This does not verify an exchange connection.
accountConnection.walletDescription: Select a wallet already connected to Nerya. We will verify balance access before linking the account.
accountConnection.walletSetupHint: Finish the provider’s login or wallet setup below, then refresh this list. The account will remain read-only.
accountConnection.busyHint: Reading balances and securely saving the connection. Keep this window open; no orders are sent.
accountConnection.successDescription: Balance access was verified and the connection was saved securely.
accountConnection.paperSuccessDescription: Your virtual account is saved. You can start exploring Nerya.
accountConnection.zeroBalance: The connection is valid. A zero balance is not an error.
accountConnection.policyKept: Your existing trading settings are unchanged.
accountConnection.session_expired: Your dashboard session expired. Sign in again, then retry.
accountConnection.auth_error: The platform rejected these credentials. Check the key, secret, required passphrase, API read permissions and IP allowlist.
accountConnection.missing_fields: Complete all required connection fields before continuing.
accountConnection.network_error: The connection could not be confirmed. Check your network and retry. Retrying the same request will not create another account.
accountConnection.rate_limited: The platform is temporarily limiting requests. Keep your inputs and retry after its limit resets.
accountConnection.wallet_not_ready: This wallet is not ready to read balances. Complete its authorization and check the selected address or network.
accountConnection.vault_unavailable: The local credential vault could not be opened. Check the vault key or unlock it in security settings. Existing credentials have not been replaced.
accountConnection.connector_unavailable: This platform’s connector is not available in the current runtime. Check the provider installation before retrying.
accountConnection.unsupported_provider: This provider does not support verified account balances. Choose a supported exchange, broker or configured wallet.
accountConnection.account_changed: This account was changed in another window. Close this editor and reopen it to use the latest settings.
accountConnection.account_exists: That account ID already exists. Edit the existing account or choose another ID under Advanced settings.
accountConnection.unknown_account: This account no longer exists. Close the editor and refresh the account list.
accountConnection.invalid_balance: Enter a valid, non-negative virtual balance.
accountConnection.invalid_account_id: Use up to 80 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens for the account ID.
accountConnection.connection_busy: Another account is being connected. Please retry once that connection finishes.
accountConnection.invalid_account: Some connection settings are invalid. Check the selected platform and its required fields.
accountConnection.provider_change_requires_new_account: Create a new account to use a different platform. Existing strategy bindings must not silently switch platforms.
accountConnection.connection_failed: The platform did not return a valid balance result. Check the credentials, network and platform status, then retry.
accountConnection.policyWarning: These settings affect trading, not connection verification. Live orders still require the runtime’s risk and approval gates.
accountConnection.enableLive: Allow live trading for this account
accountConnection.confirmPolicy: Save changes to this account’s trading permissions and risk limits? Connection verification itself never places orders.
